title: When the Scholarship Burns
premise: Ivo Okonkwo, a scholarship student at Ashgrove Academy, has spent seven years being invisible to survive — until a group chat called The Oven starts posting predictions that come true with unsettling accuracy. As the chat's anonymous architects begin weaponizing their foresight against students and staff, Ivo discovers her own baked goods carry the emotions she kneads into them, making her both the group's most valuable asset and its greatest threat. To expose them, she must win the baking championship everyone is watching — while secretly winning the student justice council election that actually decides who controls the school before the final game of the season. In the end, Ivo burns the group chat's archive publicly, chooses accountability over power, and learns that belonging built on fear was never belonging at all.
about_author: Dominic Ravensworth is the pen name of a former boarding-school scholarship kid who now writes stories about the quiet violence of institutions. They live above a bakery and insist this is not a personality trait.

chapters.title: Seven Years of Careful
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. We meet Ivo measuring her words like flour, working weekends in her father's bakery, and navigating Ashgrove as the scholarship kid who never asks for anything. When she bakes grief bread after a classmate's loss and it inexplicably comforts him, she dismisses it as coincidence. Emotional beat: the ache of being carefully invisible.

chapters.title: The Group Chat That Knew
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A friend adds her to 'The Oven,' a chat that has predicted a fire drill, a teacher's resignation, and a flooded gym — all posted hours early. Nobody admits who runs it. Ivo feels the old pull of belonging and the new pull of suspicion in equal measure. Emotional beat: intoxicating, dangerous curiosity.

chapters.title: Proofing
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. She tests the chat: it predicts a pop quiz word-for-word. Meanwhile her sourdough, kneaded with anxiety, comes out dense and bitter, and her father notices something is wrong without asking what. Emotional beat: the first crack in her careful armor.

chapters.title: The Price of Admission
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. An unknown number messages her privately: they know about her bread, and they want her inside The Oven's inner circle. Refusal means her scholarship 'situations' get reviewed. She says yes and hates herself for it. Emotional beat: coercion dressed as invitation.

chapters.title: Inner Circle
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At a midnight meeting in the boathouse, she meets four masked members who call themselves Yeast, Crumb, Crust, and Starter. They explain the gift: feelings, concentrated, can be baked into certainty. They want her hands. Emotional beat: awe curdling into dread.

chapters.title: What the Bread Does
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Forced to bake a 'confidence loaf' for a struggling athlete, Ivo watches it work — too well; he becomes reckless and gets injured. The members shrug. Ivo realizes their predictions aren't prophecy, they're engineering. Emotional beat: guilt with teeth.

chapters.title: The Championship That Doesn't Matter
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The annual Ashgrove Baking Championship is announced — a public spectacle nobody takes seriously. The inner circle orders Ivo to enter and win, using her gift on the judges. She begins plotting from inside instead. Emotional beat: reluctant resolve.

chapters.title: Crumb Breaks
chapters.summary: Crumb's POV. A member cracks under the moral weight, confessing to Ivo that the chat started as a joke among five friends and became an addiction to control. He begs her to find a way out for both of them. Emotional beat: terrified complicity.

chapters.title: Starter
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. She narrows down who 'Starter' — the founder — might be, suspecting someone with institutional access. Her investigation costs her study time and her father notices her burning loaves again. Emotional beat: obsession tightening its grip.

chapters.title: The Other Championship
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo learns the student justice council election — dismissed by everyone as boring — holds real power over disciplinary appeals, including scholarship reviews. Winning it means dismantling The Oven legally. She declares her candidacy. Emotional beat: quiet, defiant hope.

chapters.title: Sourdough Politics
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Campaigning by day, spying by night, Ivo is stretched thin. The inner circle retaliates: an anonymous post exposes her family's debts, framing her candidacy as desperation. Her father reads it at the bakery counter. Emotional beat: public humiliation, private fury.

chapters.title: Kneading Back
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Instead of hiding, Ivo bakes honesty bread for a campaign event — no manipulation, just her own steadiness kneaded in — and speaks plainly about power and shame. Support swells. Crust warns her to withdraw. Emotional beat: strength found in vulnerability.

chapters.title: The Fire Drill That Wasn't
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A prediction posts: chemistry lab fire, 2:14 PM. Ivo realizes the chat isn't predicting it — they're causing it, to frame a rival candidate. She pulls the alarm early, saving people but exposing herself to accusations of staging. Emotional beat: heroism punished.

chapters.title: Suspension Hearing
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Facing expulsion, Ivo watches the justice council — the body she wants to reform — deliberate her fate. A tie vote keeps her enrolled but on probation, and she sees exactly how arbitrary power feels from underneath. Emotional beat: cold clarity about the system.

chapters.title: Yeast Unmasked
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Following the boathouse key log, Ivo unmasks Yeast: the beloved head prefect whose perfect record was built on engineered outcomes. Confronted, Yeast offers Ivo a partnership — rule the school together. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a friendly face.

chapters.title: Refusal, Loudly
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo refuses and Yeast threatens everything: her father's lease, her scholarship, Crumb's safety. Ivo spends one last night baking with her dad, finally telling him the truth, and he gives her his old rolling pin and his blessing. Emotional beat: love as ballast.

chapters.title: Election Eve
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. On the eve of both the election and the championship finals, The Oven leaks a doctored video of Ivo admitting to the lab fire. Her support collapses overnight. Crumb goes silent. Ivo sits alone with dough that won't rise. Emotional beat: the bottom falling out.

chapters.title: The Last Proof
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Crumb resurfaces with the chat's original archive — proof of every engineered event. But uploading it means revealing his identity too. Together they plan to burn the truth into the most public moment possible: the championship stage, live-streamed. Emotional beat: terrified commitment.

chapters.title: Championship Day
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo competes honestly against judges primed by The Oven, and her unmanipulated bread — baked with seven years of care and one night of courage — wins on merit alone. Mid-ceremony, she takes the microphone. Emotional beat: earned triumph, held breath.

chapters.title: When the Scholarship Burns
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo publishes the archive to every screen in the hall, naming no victims but exposing every engineered event. The school erupts; Yeast is escorted out mid-applause. Ivo knows the fallout may cost her the scholarship — and accepts it. Emotional beat: the title moment, sacrifice made freely.

chapters.title: The Vote
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Before the season's final game, the justice council election concludes. Ivo loses the popular vote to a compromise candidate — but wins a sweeping reform mandate when the scandal forces new rules: no anonymous discipline, open hearings. Power, checked at last. Emotional beat: victory that doesn't look like winning.

chapters.title: Bread for Strangers
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Weeks later, Ivo bakes without secrets — some loaves carry joy, some grief, all offered openly. Crumb visits the bakery; her father hums; the careful girl is gone, replaced by someone who belongs because she chose it. Final beat: warmth, agency, and an open door.
